meta.git_worktree_note: working tree has uncommitted edits to other files; pipeline modules used here were imported unmodified and patched in memory only

estimand: gain(supported) - gain(unsupported), token F1 points, gain = 100*(F1 RAG - F1 closed-book)
not_causal: Support is not randomised and every label here uses the gold answer. A positive interaction says the retrieval gain differs by labelled support status; it does not say that supplying support would produce that gain, and it is not a deployable rule. The judge label is an LLM prediction on the shown text, calibrated against legacy 700-character human labels (r8_judge_validation.json), not verified semantics.
